notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Awakened Awareness by paying {U}{U}, attaching it to Tree of Redemption.
On the end step prior to your next turn, activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.
